notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Update Notes - Bug Fixes & Improvements

Boss Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where the boss could leave the map unexpectedly during gameplay. The boss will now stay within the battle area as intended.
General Bug Fixes: Addressed several other minor bugs and glitches to improve overall gameplay stability and performance.
Performance Enhancements: Optimized various elements for a smoother gaming experience across all maps.

We’re always working to improve the game! Thank you for your feedback and support. Keep clucking on!
